hints.text: This clue's indicator is 'misusing', and it's an anagram indicator - if you misuse something, you treat it in an unintended way. We'll need to treat some neighbouring letters in an unintended way by reordering them - that's how we'll find this clue's answer.
This clue's fodder is 'debit card'. We'll use these letters to construct our answer, as guided by the clue's indicator(s).

This clue is a partial &lit, a variant of an &lit. Instead of the whole clue being both wordplay and definition (like an &lit), here the whole clue is the definition and only part of the clue is the wordplay. So, our answer will be a possible consequence of misusing one's debit card.
